d: Turkey hosted this year's annual United Nations Climate Change Conference, or the COP31. The summit was chaired by the Turkish environment minister, Murat Kurum. Kurum sparked a major controversy by interrupting Ghana's environment minister, Dr. Zanetor Agyeman-Rawlings, while she was making a statement. Firstpost looks at the showdown between Kurum and the Ghanaian delegation. Hem Kaur Saroya explains why the incident was called disrespectful to both Ghana and 54 African countries. HKS also looks at how Kurum's apology also led to criticism, and why COP31 is being called the worst COP ever.
